---
title: "D7 Retention Graph Report"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
```

## Load Data (D7)

```{r}
d7 <- read_csv("D7.csv")
```

```{r}
d7$creat_date <- as.Date(d7$creat_date)
```

## Plot Graph (D7)

```{r}
ggplot(d7, aes(x = creat_date, y = D7_Retention_percent)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(
    title = "D7 Retention Over Time",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Retention (%)"
  )
```
